items.title: 67849_Leroy Elliot Stewart oral history interview
items.q: I was able to listen to especially Duke Ellington and -- there were quite a few -- Jimmie Lunceford. And it sort of was -- I was very interested -- the sound really knocked me out, you know.

ctx.x: My folks bought me a little violin, and, of course, I used to listen to the big bands on the radio. That was before -- long before TV came in. And I heard some pretty good sounds. Music so interested me, and I was sort of interested in music, listening to the big bands that used to broadcast in

Philadelphia and New York, you know, and Northwest sometimes, and I was able to listen to especially Duke Ellington and -- there were quite a few -- Jimmie Lunceford. And it sort of was -- I was very interested -- the sound really knocked me out, you know.
When you were -- what kind of a neighborhood did you grow up in?
